title: Cloud
review: This is a rather harsh punishment for scalping in my opinion. As far as I know it's illegal in Japan for finite capacity event tickets, but not for physical items. His girlfriend says she can't afford her own rent any more, but dismisses his offer to move into his apartment. He buys a house for them, and yet she does nothing but complain! It seems like all it takes for your life to fall apart in Japan is to be mildly disrespectful. There are some amazing gunshot sounds in this, on the level of {Heat}. The whole thing reminded me a bit of {Blue Ruin}, but it wasn't as subtle or dark as that. It was instead a little melodramatic and cheesy. The ending didn't quite do it for me and prevents it from obtaining a higher score, but I did like a lot of the cool moments throughout.
